summary: Nine per-SDK kwargs builder modules, each exposing build_handler_kwargs(profile). Wired via __adapter__ class variable on provider settings. S3 (boto3, flavor dispatch, STS role_arn), Azure (BlobServiceClient/ShareServiceClient, credential resolution), GCS (google.cloud.storage, service account/token/anon), SSH (paramiko connect kwargs + _post_connect), FTP (ftplib envelope: init/connect/post_connect), SMB (smbprotocol session), Local (pass-through + mount_spec), GitHub (fsspec GithubFileSystem), HTTP (httpx.Client with Timeout + auth headers).
extension_points: Write a new adapter module with build_handler_kwargs(profile) for custom SDK integration
lifecycle_notes: Phase 4: adapter pattern introduced to separate SDK-specific logic from settings classes

tests.detail: Provider tests exercise adapters via to_handler_kwargs()

risks: Azure adapter imports azure SDK classes at call time — lazy import can mask import errors until runtime
GCS adapter has complex credential resolution across 5 auth types
